message:
How many tables do you need?

• 100 guests: 13 tables of 8, 10 tables of 10, or 9 tables of 12
• 150 guests: 19, 15 or 13

Work out your own with the free table calculator, then seat guests straight from their RSVPs and print your seating chart and place cards:

https://bridalteam.com/wedding-seating-chart?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-11&utm_content=2026-11-14-noon-seating
